  <title>Evandro Ferreira — Jornalismo, imagem e comunicação</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">

  <style>
:root{
  --ink:#111412;--ink2:#181b19;--paper:#ecebe6;--paper2:#f5f4ef;--text:#1a1d1b;
  --cream:#f1f1ec;--muted:#a8aaa6;--petrol:#326873;--petrol2:#234e58;--coral:#b9634e;--gold:#b69558;
  --line-dark:rgba(241,241,236,.16);--line-light:rgba(17,20,18,.16);
  --sans:"Manrope","DM Sans",Arial,sans-serif;--serif:"Playfair Display","Newsreader",Georgia,serif;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:86px}body{margin:0;background:var(--ink);color:var(--cream);font-family:var(--sans);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}img{display:block;width:100%}a{color:inherit}button{font:inherit}.skip{position:absolute;left:-999px;top:10px;z-index:100;background:#fff;color:#111;padding:10px 14px}.skip:focus{left:10px}

.site-header{position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;z-index:50;height:76px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:28px;padding:0 5.5vw;background:rgba(13,16,14,.82);backdrop-filter:blur(16px) saturate(1.15);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px) saturate(1.15);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);transition:height .25s ease,background .25s ease}.site-header.scrolled{height:66px;background:rgba(13,16,14,.94)}.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;text-decoration:none;min-width:max-content}.brand-mark{font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.05em;font-size:1.05rem}.brand-mark span{color:var(--coral)}.brand-name{font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(241,241,236,.66)}.menu{margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}.menu a{position:relative;text-decoration:none;padding:10px 11px;font-size:.73rem;letter-spacing:.025em;color:rgba(241,241,236,.67);border-radius:999px;transition:color .2s ease,background .2s ease}.menu a:hover,.menu a:focus-visible,.menu a.active{color:#fff;background:rgba(255,255,255,.075)}.menu a.active::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:4px;width:4px;height:4px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--coral);transform:translateX(-50%)}.menu-button{display:none;margin-left:auto;align-items:center;gap:10px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);color:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:9px 13px;font-size:.72rem}.menu-button i,.menu-button i::before,.menu-button i::after{display:block;width:15px;height:1px;background:currentColor;content:"";transition:transform .2s ease}.menu-button i::before{transform:translateY(-5px)}.menu-button i::after{transform:translateY(4px)}.menu-button[aria-expanded="true"] i{background:transparent}.menu-button[aria-expanded="true"] i::before{transform:translateY(0) rotate(45deg)}.menu-button[aria-expanded="true"] i::after{transform:translateY(-1px) rotate(-45deg)}

.hero{min-height:100svh;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--ink);isolation:isolate}.hero::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-2;background-image:radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px,rgba(255,255,255,.035) .7px,transparent .8px),linear-gradient(115deg,rgba(50,104,115,.08),transparent 34%,rgba(185,99,78,.035) 69%,transparent);background-size:18px 18px,auto}.hero::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(17,20,18,.98) 0%,rgba(17,20,18,.94) 47%,rgba(17,20,18,.64) 78%,rgba(17,20,18,.35) 100%)}.hero-geometry{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none}.geo{position:absolute;display:block}.geo-circle{width:min(31vw,460px);aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;right:9vw;top:17%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 38% 36%,rgba(255,248,206,.98) 0 4%,rgba(244,197,92,.96) 10%,rgba(215,132,67,.86) 34%,rgba(185,99,78,.34) 58%,rgba(185,99,78,0) 73%);box-shadow:0 0 45px rgba(238,170,78,.24),0 0 110px rgba(185,99,78,.17);filter:saturate(.88);animation:solarPulse 5.8s ease-in-out infinite,solarDrift 11s ease-in-out infinite}.geo-circle::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-16%;border-radius:50%;background:repeating-conic-gradient(from 8deg,rgba(231,183,91,.28) 0 1deg,transparent 1deg 12deg);-webkit-mask:radial-gradient(circle,transparent 0 58%,#000 59% 100%);mask:radial-gradient(circle,transparent 0 58%,#000 59% 100%);opacity:.48;animation:solarRotate 42s linear infinite}.geo-circle::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:20%;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(255,240,188,.34);box-shadow:0 0 32px rgba(255,225,157,.16) inset}@keyframes solarPulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 45px rgba(238,170,78,.21),0 0 105px rgba(185,99,78,.14)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 62px rgba(238,170,78,.34),0 0 145px rgba(185,99,78,.22)}}@keyframes solarDrift{0%,100%{transform:translate3d(0,0,0)}50%{transform:translate3d(-10px,8px,0)}}@keyframes solarRotate{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}.geo-coral{width:min(11vw,155px);height:min(33vw,460px);right:23vw;top:36%;background:rgba(185,99,78,.27);transform:rotate(8deg);animation:geoFloatA 9s ease-in-out infinite}.geo-petrol{width:min(18vw,260px);aspect-ratio:1;right:-3vw;bottom:10%;background:rgba(50,104,115,.58);transform:rotate(-8deg);animation:geoFloatB 12s ease-in-out infinite}.geo-line{width:34vw;height:1px;right:5vw;top:51%;background:rgba(241,241,236,.22);transform:rotate(-18deg);transform-origin:right center}.geo-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;right:34vw;top:24%;background:var(--coral);box-shadow:24px 16px 0 rgba(182,149,88,.9),49px -6px 0 rgba(50,104,115,.9)}@keyframes geoFloatA{0%,100%{translate:0 0}50%{translate:0 -12px}}@keyframes geoFloatB{0%,100%{translate:0 0}50%{translate:-10px 8px}}.hero-vertical{position:absolute;right:2.5vw;bottom:46px;margin:0;writing-mode:vertical-rl;transform:rotate(180deg);font-size:.53rem;letter-spacing:.22em;color:rgba(241,241,236,.31);text-transform:uppercase}.hero-content{position:relative;z-index:2;min-height:100svh;padding:126px 6vw 46px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}.hero-kicker-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:30px;align-items:center;padding-top:15px;border-top:5px solid transparent;border-image:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--coral) 0 33%,var(--gold) 33% 66%,var(--petrol) 66% 100%) 1}.hero-kicker-row p,.hero-kicker-row span{margin:0;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.19em;font-size:.61rem;color:rgba(241,241,236,.57)}.hero h1{margin:auto 0 0;max-width:1080px;line-height:.73;color:var(--cream)}.hero h1 span{display:block}.hero h1 span:first-child{font-size:clamp(5.8rem,13vw,13.2rem);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.07em}.hero h1 span:last-child{width:max-content;margin:.08em 0 0 .18em;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(4.4rem,9.4vw,9.6rem);font-style:italic;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:0;color:#e1e2dd;line-height:.84}.hero-bottom{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:30px;align-items:end;margin-top:50px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);padding-top:20px}.hero-bottom p{margin:0;max-width:520px;line-height:1.55;font-size:clamp(.94rem,1.3vw,1.12rem);color:rgba(241,241,236,.72)}.hero-bottom a{text-decoration:none;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.16em;font-size:.65rem}.hero-bottom a span{color:var(--gold);display:inline-block;margin-left:7px;animation:nudge 1.8s ease-in-out infinite}@keyframes nudge{50%{transform:translateY(5px)}}

.paper{background-color:var(--paper);color:var(--text);background-image:radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px,rgba(17,20,18,.026) .7px,transparent .8px);background-size:22px 22px}.dark{background:var(--ink);color:var(--cream)}section:not(.hero){padding:110px 5.5vw;position:relative}.section-mark{font-size:.67rem;letter-spacing:.18em;color:var(--coral);font-weight:700}.kicker{margin:0 0 15px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.18em;font-size:.64rem;opacity:.58}h2{font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(2.8rem,6vw,6.1rem);line-height:.98;letter-spacing:-.055em;margin:0}h2 em{font-family:"Newsreader",Georgia,serif;font-weight:400;color:var(--petrol)}.dark h2 em{color:#b8cdd1}.lead{max-width:680px;line-height:1.75;opacity:.66;margin:24px 0 0}.section-heading{display:grid;grid-template-columns:70px minmax(0,1fr);gap:42px;margin-bottom:70px}.section-heading h2{max-width:1000px}
.about{display:grid;grid-template-columns:70px minmax(0,1.35fr) minmax(250px,.65fr);gap:42px;align-items:start}.about h2{max-width:1000px}.about-text{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:28px;max-width:850px;margin-top:44px}.about-text p{margin:0;line-height:1.72;color:rgba(27,30,28,.72)}.portrait{margin:42px 0 0;align-self:start}.portrait img{aspect-ratio:3/4;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 30%;filter:saturate(.88) contrast(1.02)}.portrait figcaption{font-size:.66rem;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:12px;opacity:.52}
.interlude{padding:34px 5.5vw!important;background:var(--petrol2);color:#f0f2ef;border-top:5px solid var(--coral)}.interlude p{margin:0;font-size:clamp(1.6rem,4.3vw,4.8rem);letter-spacing:-.045em;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden}.interlude span{color:#d0b273}
.looks{overflow:hidden}.gallery{column-count:3;column-gap:14px}.gallery figure{display:inline-block;width:100%;margin:0 0 14px;break-inside:avoid;position:relative;background:#171a18;vertical-align:top}.gallery-open{display:block;width:100%;padding:0;border:0;background:transparent;color:inherit;cursor:zoom-in;text-align:left}.gallery img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;transition:transform .4s ease,filter .3s ease;filter:saturate(.92) contrast(1.03)}.gallery figcaption{position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:10px;padding:5px 8px;background:rgba(9,12,10,.7);font-size:.59rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.15em;color:#fff;pointer-events:none}.gallery-open:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:4px}@media(hover:hover){.gallery figure:hover img{transform:scale(1.012);filter:saturate(1) contrast(1.02)}}
.lightbox{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:120;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:24px}.lightbox.is-open{display:flex}.lightbox-backdrop{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(5,7,6,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(7px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(7px)}.lightbox-dialog{position:relative;z-index:1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:52px minmax(0,1fr) 52px;align-items:center;width:min(96vw,1500px);max-height:92svh}.lightbox-dialog figure{margin:0;min-width:0;text-align:center}.lightbox-image{display:block;max-width:100%;max-height:82svh;width:auto;height:auto;margin:auto;box-shadow:0 22px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.42)}.lightbox-caption{margin-top:12px;color:rgba(241,241,236,.74);font-size:.66rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.16em}.lightbox-close,.lightbox-nav{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);background:rgba(16,19,17,.6);color:#fff;cursor:pointer}.lightbox-close{position:absolute;right:0;top:-48px;width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;font-size:1.4rem}.lightbox-nav{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;font-size:1.1rem}.lightbox-nav:hover,.lightbox-nav:focus-visible,.lightbox-close:hover,.lightbox-close:focus-visible{background:#fff;color:#111412}.lightbox-prev{justify-self:start}.lightbox-next{justify-self:end}body.lightbox-open{overflow:hidden}
.paths{overflow:hidden}.path-list{border-top:1px solid var(--line-light)}.path{display:grid;grid-template-columns:70px 1fr minmax(250px,470px);gap:42px;padding:30px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-light);align-items:start}.path span{color:var(--coral);font-size:.65rem}.path h3{margin:0;font-size:clamp(2rem,4vw,4.4rem);font-weight:500;line-height:.98;letter-spacing:-.05em}.path p{margin:0;line-height:1.7;color:rgba(27,30,28,.67)}
.feature{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.12fr .88fr;gap:56px;border-top:1px solid var(--line-dark);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-dark);padding:24px 0;align-items:center}.feature-image{display:block;overflow:hidden}.feature-image img{aspect-ratio:1.55/1;object-fit:cover;filter:saturate(.86);transition:transform .45s ease}.feature-image:hover img{transform:scale(1.02)}.meta{text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.15em;font-size:.6rem;color:#a9c8ce;margin:0 0 16px}.feature h3,.story-link h3{font-family:"Newsreader",Georgia,serif;font-weight:400}.feature h3{font-size:clamp(2.4rem,4.8vw,5rem);line-height:.98;margin:0 0 18px}.feature p:not(.meta){line-height:1.72;color:rgba(242,241,234,.65)}.read-link{display:inline-block;margin-top:12px;text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid var(--petrol);padding-bottom:3px;font-size:.8rem}.story-pair{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px;margin-top:18px}.story-link{position:relative;display:flex;min-height:410px;flex-direction:column;padding:34px;text-decoration:none;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.11);isolation:isolate;transition:transform .25s ease,border-color .25s ease}.story-link::before,.story-link::after{content:"";position:absolute;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none}.story-link::before{width:260px;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;right:-75px;top:-75px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16)}.story-link::after{width:150px;height:240px;right:52px;bottom:-90px;transform:rotate(15deg);opacity:.28}.story-solar{background:linear-gradient(140deg,#17343a,#14211e 66%)}.story-solar::after{background:var(--gold)}.story-hiv{background:linear-gradient(140deg,#2b2623,#171a18 67%)}.story-hiv::after{background:var(--coral)}.story-link:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.24)}.story-number{margin-left:auto;font-size:.65rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);letter-spacing:.16em}.story-link .meta{margin-top:auto}.story-link h3{font-size:clamp(2rem,3.2vw,3.6rem);line-height:1;margin:0 0 18px;max-width:600px}.story-link p:not(.meta){max-width:610px;line-height:1.68;color:rgba(241,241,236,.62);margin:0}.story-arrow{margin-top:24px;font-size:.74rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase}
.archive{overflow:hidden}.archive-lead{color:rgba(27,30,28,.63);opacity:1}.archive-toolbar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:28px;margin:0 0 26px 112px}.archive-filters{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}.archive-filter{border:1px solid rgba(17,20,18,.2);background:transparent;color:var(--text);border-radius:999px;padding:9px 14px;font-size:.7rem;cursor:pointer}.archive-filter:hover,.archive-filter:focus-visible,.archive-filter.is-active{background:var(--ink);color:var(--cream);border-color:var(--ink)}.archive-range{margin:0;min-width:max-content;font-family:"Newsreader",Georgia,serif;font-size:1.15rem;color:rgba(27,30,28,.4)}.archive-range span{padding:0 8px;color:var(--coral)}.archive-list{border-top:1px solid var(--line-light)}.archive-item{display:grid;grid-template-columns:90px minmax(0,1.7fr) minmax(170px,.8fr) 28px;gap:22px;align-items:center;padding:25px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-light);text-decoration:none;transition:padding-left .2s ease,background .2s ease}.archive-item:hover,.archive-item:focus-visible{padding-left:10px;background:rgba(17,20,18,.025)}.archive-item[hidden]{display:none}.archive-year{font-size:.67rem;color:var(--coral);font-weight:700}.archive-title{font-size:clamp(1.1rem,2vw,1.65rem);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.025em}.archive-source{font-size:.7rem;line-height:1.5;color:rgba(27,30,28,.55)}.archive-arrow{text-align:right}.archive-note{margin:26px 0 0 112px;max-width:820px;font-size:.72rem;line-height:1.6;color:rgba(27,30,28,.52)}
.contact{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.85fr) minmax(0,1.15fr);gap:7vw;align-items:center}.contact-copy h2{max-width:800px}.contact-copy>p:not(.kicker){max-width:560px;line-height:1.75;color:rgba(27,30,28,.67);margin:30px 0}.contact-links{display:flex;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap}.contact-links a{text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid currentColor;padding-bottom:3px;font-size:.8rem}.contact-photo{margin:0;overflow:hidden}.contact-photo img{aspect-ratio:16/9;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 42%;filter:saturate(.87) contrast(1.02)}footer{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;padding:26px 5.5vw;background:var(--ink2);color:rgba(242,241,234,.55);font-size:.68rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.12em}
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px);transition:opacity .7s ease,transform .7s ease}.reveal.visible{opacity:1;transform:none}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}.reveal{opacity:1;transform:none;transition:none}.hero-bottom a span,.geo-circle,.geo-circle::before,.geo-coral,.geo-petrol{animation:none}}
@media(max-width:1000px){.brand-name{display:none}.site-header{padding:0 22px}.menu-button{display:flex}.menu{position:absolute;left:14px;right:14px;top:68px;display:none;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:2px;padding:10px;background:rgba(19,22,20,.97);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.28)}.menu.open{display:flex}.menu a{padding:13px 14px;border-radius:10px}.menu a.active::after{display:none}.hero-content{padding:118px 22px 34px}.hero-kicker-row span{display:none}.hero h1 span:first-child{font-size:clamp(5rem,19vw,9.5rem)}.hero h1 span:last-child{font-size:clamp(4rem,14vw,7.3rem);margin-left:.08em}.hero-bottom{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}.geo-circle{right:-6vw;top:18%;width:min(55vw,420px)}.geo-coral{right:24vw;width:18vw;height:50vw}.geo-petrol{width:31vw}.hero-vertical{display:none}.about,.section-heading{grid-template-columns:1fr}.about{gap:38px}.about>.section-mark{display:none}.about-text{grid-template-columns:1fr}.portrait{max-width:540px;margin-top:0}.gallery{column-count:2}.gallery figure{margin-bottom:12px}.path{grid-template-columns:45px 1fr}.path p{grid-column:2}.feature,.contact{grid-template-columns:1fr}.story-pair{grid-template-columns:1fr}.archive-toolbar,.archive-note{margin-left:0}.archive-toolbar{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}.archive-range{display:none}.archive-item{grid-template-columns:70px minmax(0,1fr) 24px}.archive-source{grid-column:2}.archive-arrow{grid-column:3;grid-row:1/3}.contact-photo{max-width:820px}section:not(.hero){padding:88px 22px}.interlude{padding:26px 22px!important}}
@media(max-width:560px){html{scroll-padding-top:72px}.site-header,.site-header.scrolled{height:62px}.menu{top:66px}.hero-content{min-height:100svh;padding-top:100px}.hero h1{margin-top:auto}.hero h1 span:first-child{font-size:clamp(4.5rem,22vw,7.2rem);line-height:.78}.hero h1 span:last-child{font-size:clamp(3.5rem,16vw,5.7rem);line-height:.88;margin-top:.12em}.geo-circle{width:72vw;right:-20vw;top:25%}.geo-coral{width:23vw;height:73vw;right:18vw;top:38%;opacity:.8}.geo-petrol{width:42vw;right:-13vw;bottom:14%}.hero-bottom{margin-top:38px}.gallery{column-count:1;column-gap:0}.gallery figure{margin-bottom:10px}.lightbox{padding:14px}.lightbox-dialog{grid-template-columns:42px minmax(0,1fr) 42px}.lightbox-image{max-height:76svh}.lightbox-nav{width:38px;height:38px}.section-mark{display:none}.section-heading{margin-bottom:45px}.path{grid-template-columns:34px 1fr;gap:18px}.path p{grid-column:2}.feature{gap:28px}.feature-image img{aspect-ratio:4/3}.story-link{min-height:390px;padding:26px}.archive-item{grid-template-columns:52px 1fr 22px;gap:14px}.archive-title{font-size:1rem}.archive-source{font-size:.64rem}.interlude p{font-size:2rem}.contact-links{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}.contact-photo img{aspect-ratio:4/3;object-position:center 38%}footer{flex-direction:column}}


/* ===== V7 — paisagem gráfica + fotografias preservadas ===== */
.site-header{background:transparent;border-bottom-color:transparent;backdrop-filter:none;-webkit-backdrop-filter:none}
.site-header.scrolled{background:rgba(13,16,14,.91);border-bottom-color:rgba(255,255,255,.09);backdrop-filter:blur(16px) saturate(1.12);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px) saturate(1.12)}

.hero{background:#101310}
.hero::before{z-index:-4;background:
  radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px,rgba(255,255,255,.026) .72px,transparent .82px),
  radial-gradient(ellipse at 74% 18%,rgba(75,104,105,.10),transparent 43%),
  linear-gradient(180deg,#121613 0%,#101310 58%,#0d100e 100%);background-size:18px 18px,auto,auto}
.hero::after{z-index:-3;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(9,12,10,.35) 0%,rgba(9,12,10,.10) 50%,rgba(9,12,10,.18) 100%)}
.hero-geometry{z-index:-1}
.sky-grain{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:.33;background-image:radial-gradient(circle at 20% 18%,rgba(255,255,255,.20) 0 1px,transparent 1.2px),radial-gradient(circle at 73% 31%,rgba(255,255,255,.13) 0 .8px,transparent 1px);background-size:190px 170px,240px 210px;mix-blend-mode:screen}
.moon-halo{position:absolute;width:min(48vw,720px);aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;right:4.5vw;top:-9%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(198,118,82,.18) 0 46%,rgba(151,88,66,.10) 58%,rgba(151,88,66,0) 72%);filter:blur(8px);animation:moonBreath 7.5s ease-in-out infinite}
.moon{position:absolute;width:min(40vw,610px);aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;right:8.5vw;top:-3.5%;background:
  radial-gradient(circle at 42% 37%,rgba(143,86,65,.92) 0 9%,rgba(112,65,50,.97) 46%,rgba(83,47,38,.98) 100%);
  box-shadow:0 0 42px rgba(187,105,72,.17),0 0 120px rgba(125,71,51,.13),inset 18px -22px 80px rgba(36,22,18,.24);animation:moonFloat 12s ease-in-out infinite}
.moon::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;opacity:.18;background:radial-gradient(circle at 31% 42%,rgba(255,255,255,.22) 0 2%,transparent 2.5%),radial-gradient(circle at 67% 60%,rgba(0,0,0,.28) 0 4%,transparent 4.5%),radial-gradient(circle at 54% 25%,rgba(0,0,0,.20) 0 2.2%,transparent 2.7%);background-size:155px 140px,210px 190px,130px 120px}
.dune{position:absolute;display:block;pointer-events:none;border-radius:50% 50% 0 0/100% 100% 0 0;transform-origin:center bottom}
.dune-back{width:118vw;height:44vw;min-height:370px;left:7vw;bottom:-24vw;background:#171a18;transform:rotate(-7deg);box-shadow:0 -1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.025)}
.dune-front{width:108vw;height:34vw;min-height:300px;left:37vw;bottom:-22vw;background:#0c0f0d;transform:rotate(-13deg);box-shadow:0 -1px 0 rgba(185,99,78,.08)}
.geo-line-horizon{position:absolute;width:31vw;height:1px;right:9vw;top:48%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(233,231,222,.20),transparent);transform:rotate(-14deg)}
.geo-star{position:absolute;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#e6ded0;box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(239,221,194,.35);opacity:.56}.star-a{right:41vw;top:25%}.star-b{right:29vw;top:36%;width:4px;height:4px;opacity:.38}
@keyframes moonFloat{0%,100%{transform:translate3d(0,0,0)}50%{transform:translate3d(-7px,7px,0)}}
@keyframes moonBreath{0%,100%{opacity:.78;transform:scale(1)}50%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.025)}}

.hero-content{z-index:3}
.hero h1{position:relative;z-index:4;max-width:980px}
.hero h1 span:first-child{font-weight:650;letter-spacing:-.068em;text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.03)}
.hero h1 span:last-child{letter-spacing:.002em;color:#ecebe6;text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.025)}
.hero-kicker-row{border-top-width:1px;border-image:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(185,99,78,.72),rgba(182,149,88,.45),rgba(50,104,115,.16),transparent 72%) 1}
.hero-bottom{border-top-color:rgba(255,255,255,.13)}

/* A galeria respeita integralmente as proporções originais. */
.gallery{column-count:3;column-gap:16px}
.gallery figure{margin:0 0 16px;background:transparent;overflow:visible}
.gallery-open{overflow:hidden;background:#151815}
.gallery img{width:100%;height:auto;object-fit:contain;transform:none!important}
.gallery figcaption{bottom:9px;left:9px}

/* O Morro do Careca deixa de ser "banner": aparece inteiro, na proporção original,
   mas agora fica proporcional ao bloco de texto, sem sobrar um grande trecho abaixo. */
.contact{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.05fr) minmax(300px,.72fr);gap:clamp(30px,5.5vw,84px);align-items:center}
.contact-copy{max-width:720px}
.contact-photo{margin:0;overflow:visible;max-width:420px;justify-self:end;align-self:center;width:100%}
.contact-photo-open{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;align-items:center;width:100%;border:0;padding:0;background:transparent;cursor:zoom-in;overflow:visible}
.contact-photo img{display:block;width:auto;max-width:100%;height:auto;max-height:min(72vh,620px);aspect-ratio:auto;object-fit:contain;object-position:initial;filter:saturate(.93) contrast(1.015);box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.08)}
.contact-photo figcaption{margin-top:10px;font-size:.64rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(27,30,28,.52);text-align:right}

@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.moon,.moon-halo{animation:none}}
@media(max-width:1000px){
  .site-header{background:rgba(13,16,14,.20);backdrop-filter:blur(7px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(7px)}
  .moon{width:min(61vw,520px);right:-7vw;top:8%}.moon-halo{width:min(72vw,620px);right:-13vw;top:4%}
  .dune-back{width:150vw;height:59vw;left:-7vw;bottom:-30vw}.dune-front{width:150vw;height:49vw;left:28vw;bottom:-32vw}
  .gallery{column-count:2}
  .contact{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .contact-photo{justify-self:start;max-width:480px;align-self:start}
}
@media(max-width:560px){
  .moon{width:82vw;right:-31vw;top:12%}.moon-halo{width:98vw;right:-39vw;top:9%}
  .dune-back{width:205vw;height:84vw;left:-32vw;bottom:-47vw;transform:rotate(-9deg)}
  .dune-front{width:195vw;height:68vw;left:22vw;bottom:-48vw;transform:rotate(-14deg)}
  .geo-line-horizon{width:52vw;right:-2vw;top:49%}.star-a{right:51vw}.star-b{right:35vw}
  .gallery{column-count:1;column-gap:0}.gallery figure{margin-bottom:12px}
  .contact-photo{max-width:100%}
  .contact-photo img{width:100%;max-height:none}
  .contact-photo figcaption{text-align:left}
}


/* ===== Refinamento mobile + contatos + voltar ao topo ===== */
.contact-methods{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;max-width:680px;margin-top:30px}
.contact-method{position:relative;min-height:88px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:7px;padding:16px 44px 16px 16px;border:1px solid rgba(27,30,28,.16);border-radius:10px;text-decoration:none;background:rgba(255,255,255,.34);transition:transform .2s ease,border-color .2s ease,background .2s ease}
.contact-method:hover,.contact-method:focus-visible{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:rgba(50,104,115,.52);background:rgba(255,255,255,.64)}
.contact-method-label{font-size:.60rem;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(27,30,28,.52)}
.contact-method-value{font-size:.86rem;line-height:1.35;color:rgba(27,30,28,.88);overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.contact-method-arrow{position:absolute;right:16px;top:16px;color:var(--petrol);font-size:.88rem}
.back-to-top{position:fixed;right:18px;bottom:18px;z-index:70;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;min-width:46px;height:46px;padding:0 14px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:999px;background:rgba(13,16,14,.90);color:#f2f1ea;text-decoration:none;box-shadow:0 10px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.22);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:translateY(10px);transition:opacity .22s ease,transform .22s ease,background .2s ease}
.back-to-top.is-visible{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;transform:translateY(0)}
.back-to-top:hover,.back-to-top:focus-visible{background:#1b201d}.back-to-top>span:first-child{font-size:1.05rem;line-height:1}.back-to-top-text{font-size:.57rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase}
@media(max-width:560px){section:not(.hero){padding:62px 20px}.interlude{padding:20px 20px!important}.section-heading{margin-bottom:30px}.kicker{margin-bottom:10px}.lead{margin-top:18px}.about{gap:24px}.about-text{margin-top:24px;gap:17px}.portrait{margin-top:2px}.gallery{margin-top:2px}.paths .section-heading,.stories .section-heading,.archive .section-heading{margin-bottom:32px}.path{padding:22px 0}.story-pair{gap:12px}.archive-toolbar{margin-bottom:22px}.archive-item{padding:19px 0}.contact{gap:30px}.contact-copy>p:not(.kicker){margin:22px 0 0}.contact-methods{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:8px;margin-top:24px}.contact-method{min-height:76px;padding:14px 42px 14px 14px}.contact-photo{margin-top:0}footer{padding:22px 20px 82px}.back-to-top{right:14px;bottom:14px;width:46px;min-width:46px;padding:0}.back-to-top-text{display:none}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<a class="skip" href="#conteudo">Pular para o conteúdo</a>

<header class="site-header" id="topo">
  <a class="brand" href="#capa" aria-label="Voltar ao início">
    <span class="brand-mark">EF<span>·</span></span>
    <span class="brand-name">Evandro Ferreira</span>
  </a>
  <button class="menu-button" type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="menu">
    <span>Menu</span><i aria-hidden="true"></i>
  </button>
  <nav id="menu" class="menu" aria-label="Navegação principal">
    <a href="#sobre">Sobre</a>
    <a href="#olhares">Olhares</a>
    <a href="#percursos">Percursos</a>
    <a href="#historias">Histórias</a>
    <a href="#arquivo">Arquivo</a>
    <a href="#contato">Contato</a>
  </nav>
</header>

<main id="conteudo">
  <section class="hero" id="capa" aria-labelledby="hero-title">
    <div class="hero-geometry" aria-hidden="true">
      <span class="sky-grain"></span>
      <span class="moon-halo"></span>
      <span class="moon"></span>
      <span class="dune dune-back"></span>
      <span class="dune dune-front"></span>
      <span class="geo-star star-a"></span>
      <span class="geo-star star-b"></span>
      <span class="geo-line-horizon"></span>
    </div>
    <p class="hero-vertical" aria-hidden="true">NATAL / RN — LUZ, CONCRETO, MOVIMENTO</p>
    <div class="hero-content">
      <div class="hero-kicker-row">
        <p class="hero-kicker">Natal · Rio Grande do Norte · Brasil</p>
        <span>jornalismo / imagem / comunicação</span>
      </div>
      <h1 id="hero-title"><span>Evandro</span><span>Ferreira</span></h1>
      <div class="hero-bottom">
        <p>Histórias em texto, imagem e movimento.<br>Um espaço para percursos, olhares e projetos.</p>
        <a href="#sobre">Explorar <span aria-hidden="true">↓</span></a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="about paper" id="sobre">
    <div class="section-mark">01</div>
    <div class="about-copy reveal">
      <p class="kicker">Um pouco de mim</p>
      <h2>Entre informação, imagem e experiência, procuro encontrar um jeito <em>claro e humano</em> de contar.</h2>
      <div class="about-text">
        <p>Sou jornalista formado pela Universidade Federal do Rio Grande do Norte. Minha trajetória passa por reportagem, audiovisual, comunicação institucional, ciência e produção digital.</p>
        <p>Este site não foi pensado como uma vitrine tradicional. É um espaço para reunir percursos, imagens, histórias e projetos que dizem algo sobre o modo como observo e comunico o mundo.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <figure class="portrait reveal">
      <img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Retrato de Evandro Ferreira">
      <figcaption>Evandro Ferreira · Natal/RN</figcaption>
    </figure>
  </section>

  <section class="interlude" aria-label="Temas do site">
    <p>cidade <span>·</span> ciência <span>·</span> cultura <span>·</span> memória <span>·</span> cotidiano</p>
  </section>

  <section class="looks dark" id="olhares">
    <div class="section-heading reveal">
      <div class="section-mark">02</div>
      <div><p class="kicker">Olhares</p><h2>Há coisas que prefiro contar <em>sem muitas palavras.</em></h2><p class="lead">Uma seleção de imagens feitas ao longo do caminho. Cidade, litoral, interior, cultura popular, ciência e pequenos encontros.</p></div>
    </div>
    <div class="gallery" aria-label="Galeria de fotografias">
      <figure class="reveal">
        <button class="gallery-open" type="button" data-full="data:image/webp;base64,
